value.signature: fn write_str (& mut self , value : & str) -> std :: fmt :: Result

exception.justification: Justified: Fixed-stack request framing inherits the reader's operation and owns no secret.

review.body: { let end = self . len . checked_add (value . len ()) . ok_or (std :: fmt :: Error) ? ; self . bytes . get_mut (self . len .. end) . ok_or (std :: fmt :: Error) ? . copy_from_slice (value . as_bytes ()) ; self . len = end ; Ok (()) }
review.item_premise: The bounded server reader retains the existing protected Session and read-only transaction. Closed statements deliver only bounded public metadata and canonical retained evidence; all variable projections carry their stored lengths. The shared allowance admits delivery reservations, strict-validator requests and reconstruction before execution. Returned owned bytes and origins grant no admitted capability. Session configuration, cancellation and diagnostics retain their existing carriers; no new secret exit or transport path is introduced. Operation observation is outside reconstruction accounting.
